items.headline: The Curator welcomes 4,000 new salvagers to the Archive
items.body: Report to the museum for your first contract. Every artifact recovered brings the world one step closer to remembering.

items.headline: New landmass sighted east of the Archive: white cliffs, golden temple
items.body: Survey drones report constant updrafts around the summit. Salvage permits open at dawn.

items.headline: Day of Remembrance: the city falls silent for the Drowning
items.body: Archive records of the date remain sealed by order of the Curator, for the public good.

items.headline: Record find: winged sandals recovered intact
items.body: The salvager responsible declined interviews. Exhibit opens next cycle in the east hall.

items.headline: Health advisory: Grey Rot cases linked to the southern reefs
items.body: Symptoms include slow loss of strength. The Archive clinic reports no known cure within city limits.

items.headline: Market report: divine relic prices up 40% after storm season
items.body: Traders blame the shortage on fewer crews braving open water. Common salvage remains steady.

items.headline: Third crew this month fails to return from fog-bound island
items.body: Survivors of earlier expeditions describe a town where the roads all lead back to the square.

items.headline: Museum extends hours: the low-gravity hall now open to all
items.body: Visitors are reminded not to jump near the exhibits. The Curator thanks you for your patience.

items.headline: Permanent storm over the northern rim shows no sign of moving
items.body: Lightning strikes recorded at three per second. Sailors report a shape in the water below.

items.headline: Curator: 'Every exhibit is a promise kept'
items.body: In a rare statement, the Curator thanked salvagers for 'returning what the sea took'. No questions were taken.

items.headline: Archive dismisses rumours that islands are sinking
items.body: Tide gauges near recently looted ruins show a rise of 30 cm. Officials call the readings 'instrument drift'.

items.headline: Reminder: the Archive guards do not intervene in duels
items.body: Salvagers carrying valuable cargo are advised to travel in crews.

items.headline: Divers report a lit palace on the sea floor
items.body: Witnesses describe a staff that grew to the height of a tower before vanishing. Salvage unconfirmed.

items.headline: Memory clinic waiting list reaches six months
items.body: New arrivals with no memory of their past should register with the Curator's office as normal.

items.headline: Hunters' horns heard over the frozen isle again
items.body: Fishermen claim riders crossed the sky at midnight. The Archive asks salvagers not to answer the call.

items.headline: Unreadable tattoos spotted on several new arrivals
items.body: Linguists at the Archive describe the script as 'older than the Drowning'. Research is ongoing.

items.headline: Rumour: springs beneath the white cliffs can cure the Rot
items.body: The clinic warns that no one has returned from below to confirm it.

items.headline: Every new salvager receives 100 marks to start a new life
items.body: Spend wisely. The market buys anything you cannot carry.

items.headline: Faint signal detected from above the clouds
items.body: Engineers say the pattern repeats every eight minutes, matching the length of an Archive day.

items.headline: [REDACTED] confirms [REDACTED] at the [REDACTED]
items.body: This bulletin has been withdrawn by order of the Curator. Thank you for watching.
